/look_brief.audience: a lending bank's credit committee and the sponsor's deal team, who check every figure, compare each year with the last and look for covenant headroom
/look_brief.occasion: two pages of a credit committee book, printed on letter paper and read line by line at a desk before the committee meets; never projected
/look_brief.subject_world: freight railroads run on waybills, consist lists and the employee timetable: ruled grids with heavy rules between sections and one figure per cell. The pages borrow that convention (a heavy rule opening each block, hairlines between lines, block heads on a pale band) and leave out track motifs, locomotive pictures and signal red and green, which would be costume with no job
/look_brief.data_character: five fiscal years of a full credit profile: volume, revenue by five commodities, profit, cash flow and leverage, 22 lines in five blocks, plus two covenant tests and a commodity mix; one long table on the first page and five exhibits on the second

density.target: extremely dense, banker style: a 27-row table at 8pt on the first page beside a credit-notes column; five exhibits on the second page
density.why: a lender reads every line of every year and wants the whole profile and the covenant tests on facing pages to compare without turning; splitting the table would separate a figure from the years it is compared with

/look_brief.look: banker-plain: white paper, near-black Liberation Sans, a deep rail green for Larkspur's own figures and the page structure, amber reserved for covenant thresholds, grey for history; ruled like a waybill, topic titles with a units line, nothing decorative

colour_meanings.color.accent1: Larkspur's own figures and the page's structure: the title rule, the latest year, the lead series
colour_meanings.color.accent2: a covenant threshold and nothing else: the leverage maximum line and the covenant column
colour_meanings.color.accent3: history and context: prior years in a chart, the 2021 mix
colour_meanings.color.negative: a worsening on the year before, in the lender's terms: revenue or a line that fell, leverage that rose, headroom that shrank
colour_meanings.color.surface_alt: a block head in a table, as a waybill marks its sections

/look_brief.type_ladder: built from the first page: 27 rows of five years plus a CAGR column fit in 7 in only at 8pt cells, so table text is 8pt; footnotes, sources and axis labels a half step under at 7.5pt, above the 7pt floor, which was measured on Arial, the face Liberation Sans matches metric for metric; body and notes at 9pt, exhibit heads at 10pt, an 18pt topic title that stays on one line

rejected.what: claim titles stating the credit view
rejected.why: a bank book titles by topic and states the view in the notes column; the committee forms its own view from the figures

rejected.what: a coloured header fill on the tables
rejected.why: on a 27-row table a filled header is the loudest thing on the page and says nothing; a heavy rule does the separating
at 27 rows banding reads as stripes and competes with the block heads, which are the grouping that matters
labelled columns and one threshold line carry every value the reader quotes
five hues would give colour five meanings; the mix is a table where shares read as figures

/reference/page.why: US letter landscape, 11 x 8.5 in, because the book is printed and read on paper

/typography/roles/type.title.why: a topic title on one line, the largest thing on the page and still modest

/typography/roles/type.kicker.why: the section tag above the title in Larkspur green

/typography/roles/type.h1.why: an exhibit head, two steps over the table text, in the structure colour

/typography/roles/type.h2.why: a run-in head at body size in the notes column

/typography/roles/type.body.why: notes read at a desk: one step over the table text

/typography/roles/type.emphasis.why: the bold run inside a note

/typography/roles/type.caption.why: the units line under an exhibit head

/typography/roles/type.footnote.why: definitions under the table, half a step under the cells and above the floor

/typography/roles/type.source_line.why: the source under each exhibit, set like a footnote

/typography/roles/type.table_header.why: bold year heads over a heavy rule, at the cell size

/typography/roles/type.table_cell.why: the densest text in the book: 27 rows fit at 8pt

/typography/roles/type.axis_label.why: chart axis text, quieter than the values

/typography/roles/type.data_label.why: values on the columns, bold so the figure is read before the bar

/color/roles/color.surface_alt.why: a pale warm grey for block heads, light enough that 8pt ink reads on it

/color/roles/color.ink.why: near-black text that prints dense and sharp

/color/roles/color.ink_muted.why: secondary text above 4.5:1 on white and on the block heads

/color/roles/color.accent1.why: a deep rail green for Larkspur's own figures and the structure

/color/roles/color.accent2.why: a dark amber for covenant thresholds only, dark enough to read as text

/color/roles/color.accent3.why: a grey for history and context that recedes

/color/roles/color.negative.why: a brick red for a worsening on the year before

/chrome.why: a green rule closes the title zone, the one structural line every page shares

/chrome.text: Larkspur Rail Freight  Credit committee book  Illustrative figures
/chrome.why: a printed page has to say whose book it is and that its figures are illustrative
page numbers for a book the committee refers to by page

/tables.why: ruled like a waybill: a heavy rule under the heads and at the foot, hairlines between lines, no fills but the block heads

/charts.why: labelled columns in green, one amber threshold line, no gridlines

/description.summary: Banker-plain and ruled like a waybill: white letter pages, near-black Liberation Sans, deep rail green for Larkspur's figures and structure, amber only for covenant thresholds.
/description.typography: Liberation Sans throughout on an 18, 10, 9, 8, 7.5pt ladder built down to the 8pt table.
/description.color: Green is Larkspur, amber is a covenant, grey is history, brick red a worsening on the year before; nothing else is coloured.
/description.layout: 0.5in margins, a topic title over a green rule, a wide table beside a notes column or three exhibits on a 0.25in gutter.
/description.tables: No header fill, a heavy ink rule under the heads and at the foot, hairlines between lines, pale block heads.
/description.motifs: the green title rule; block heads on a pale band

/continuation.why: a split table repeats its title with (continued) and its year heads

/extra_roles/color.ink_inverse.why: values set inside the green and red columns
